text: 4-day-old newborn. The newborn was born at term with no complications. The mother had no prenatal care and has a history of gonorrhea treated 4 years ago. The newborn presents with a generalized rash that has been present for 1 day.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Congenital Syphilis. The 4-day-old age of onset with a generalized rash and a maternal history of gonorrhea (syphilis co-infection is common) is highly suggestive, even though the CBC and coagulation studies were normal. I am ready to proceed with treatment.
